title: Enlarging a prescribed prime-power subgroup by one power
statement: Let $G$ be a group with finite underlying set [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set], let $p$ be prime and let $n\geq0$ be an integer. Suppose $p^{n+1}$ divides $|G|$, and let $H\subseteq G$ be a subgroup with $|H|=p^n$. Then there exists a subgroup $K\subseteq G$ such that $H\subseteq K$ and $|K|=p^{n+1}$. Here $|G|,|H|,|K|$ count elements; a subgroup is a subset containing $1$ and closed under multiplication and inverse.
